main_measure.name: mean unusual 7-bar move after long bets

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and the supporting check) to confirm; mean < 0 with t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move above-median forecast minus below-median, grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2 (or cannot be computed), which the plan calls inconclusive. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.669 (below 1), 390 cases (30 needed).
reading: One case per 7-bar grid cell (the cell's first long bet, a forecast rise of at least 2 from its lowest level since the last bet), its return taken from that bet's close over 7 bars inside the window minus the coin's mean grid 7-bar return over all windows; the day-grouped t is the clustered t of the mean; the supporting check uses the grid bars themselves with ties at the median left out; the 30-case minimum is counted in independent days and, per the workflow, gives 'not observable'.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.669 (below 1), 390 cases (30 needed)
